_comment: Accepted npm advisories for PRODUCTION dependencies (scripts/audit-gate.mjs). Every entry needs a reason and a reviewBy date; the gate fails once a date has passed, so nothing is accepted forever by accident. Anything high or critical that is not listed here fails the release.

accepted.reason: Memory exhaustion when validating oversized constrained collections. The fix is only in zod 4, and Grip's tool schemas depend on zod 3 plus zod-to-json-schema. The only input is a tool call from the user's own agent over loopback, so exposure is limited to the user's machine. Revisit with the zod 4 migration.
